summary: Ryde Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing it received an NYSE Regulation letter confirming compliance with NYSE American continued listing standards. The company resolved a deficiency under Section 1003(a)(ii) by demonstrating compliance for two consecutive quarters. No transaction or special situation event occurred; the filing is a routine compliance update. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are applicable. The BC indicator will be removed. Watch for potential delisting proceedings if noncompliance recurs within 12 months.
